cases.sentence: Господи, ___ спасения моего, днем и ночью взываю к Тебе.
cases.explain: Direct address to God uses the vocative case (or nominative in modern Russian).

cases.sentence: Я стал, как те, кто спускается в ___.
cases.explain: The verb спускается (descends) is followed by the accusative preposition в.
The preposition между (among) governs the instrumental case.
The verb положил (laid) takes the accusative case for its object.
The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я заключен и не могу выйти, глаза истомились от ___.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.
The verb творишь (perform) takes the accusative, but in this context refers to plural genitive.
After the copula verb быть (to be), the predicate nominative stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Господи, Бог спасения моего, днем и ночью взываю к Тебе, пусть достигнет Тебя молитва моя, услышь мою мольбу.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask God to do?
options: To hear his prayer and supplication
reading.correct: To hear his prayer and supplication
reading.explain: The text says пусть достигнет Тебя молитва моя, услышь мою мольбу — let my prayer reach You, hear my supplication.

reading.ru: Насытилась душа моя страданиями, и жизнь моя приблизилась к миру мертвых.
reading.question: What has happened to the psalmist's soul?
options: It is full of troubles and near death
reading.correct: It is full of troubles and near death
reading.explain: Душа насытилась страданиями и жизнь приблизилась к миру мертвых — his soul is full of troubles and his life has come near to the realm of the dead.

reading.ru: Я брошен между мертвыми, я подобен убитым, лежащим в могиле.
reading.question: To whom does the psalmist compare himself?
options: To the slain lying in the grave
reading.correct: To the slain lying in the grave
reading.explain: Я подобен убитым, лежащим в могиле — I am like the slain who lie in the grave.

reading.ru: Ты отвратил от меня друзей моих, сделал меня для них страшилищем.
reading.question: How does God treat the psalmist's friendships?
options: He has turned friends away and made him a horror to them
He has honored him among friends
He has kept his friends close
reading.correct: He has turned friends away and made him a horror to them
reading.explain: Ты отвратил друзей и сделал меня страшилищем — God has turned friends away and made him a horror to them.

reading.ru: Зачем ты, Господи, отвергаешь мою душу? Зачем скрываешь от меня лицо свое?
reading.question: What is the psalmist's complaint about God?
options: That God rejects his soul and hides His face
That God is angry with the earth
reading.correct: That God rejects his soul and hides His face
reading.explain: отвергаешь мою душу ... скрываешь лицо — God rejects his soul and hides His face.

reading.ru: Твоя ярость прошла надо мною, твои устрашения сокрушили меня.
reading.question: What has God's anger done to the psalmist?
options: His fierce anger and terrors have overwhelmed him
His anger has passed him by
reading.correct: His fierce anger and terrors have overwhelmed him
reading.explain: Ты́ова ярость прошла надо мною, твои устрашения сокрушили меня — God's anger has passed over him and His terrors have crushed him.
